single.rationale: Bowman shows compelling improvement with revenue growing 15% to $490M, operating margin turning positive at 4.0% after two years of losses, and free cash flow expanding to $33.4M (6.8% margin). The company operates in attractive infrastructure end-markets with 73% repeat customer revenue, strong 23% three-year revenue CAGR, and reasonable valuation at 17x P/FCF despite execution risks around M&A integration and CEO succession.
